recognize_zh: 低倍 CD10 染色可見大量密集、形狀不規則且互相融合的 CD10 陽性結節，結節之間為陰性的淡藍色區域；CD10 陽性證實結節由生發中心來源的 B 細胞組成。
features: Low power: numerous closely packed, irregular CD10-positive nodules with back-to-back arrangement
Nodules vary in size and some are confluent
Strong staining within nodules with small clear/unstained holes
Interfollicular areas largely CD10 negative with scattered faint positivity
Nodules occupy most of the section
describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry at low power highlights numerous closely packed, irregular and focally confluent nodules composed of CD10-positive cells, separated by largely CD10-negative interfollicular zones. The staining confirms the germinal center B-cell phenotype of the nodular population replacing the node. The distribution parallels the CD20-positive nodules and is consistent with follicular lymphoma; BCL2 expression within the follicles supports neoplasia.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are also CD10 positive, but they are fewer and better spaced, with mantle zones and BCL2-negative germinal center cells.
NMZL cells are CD10 negative, with only residual colonized germinal centers staining.
MCL nodules are CD10 negative and cyclin D1 positive.
